deviations: Test file split into capacity.test.ts (cap maths, overrides, purity) and capacity-stats.test.ts (vm_stat/meminfo/freemem readings) to stay under the 300-line eslint limit.
readMachineStats takes an optional meminfoPath so the CLI's hidden --meminfo test flag (design 2.4) can point the Linux path at a fixture.

When vm_stat or meminfo output cannot be parsed, readMachineStats falls back to os.freemem with mem_source 'os.freemem' instead of throwing, so a format change degrades visibly rather than stopping the cycle.
computeCapacity takes the ledger control object ({paused,maxWorkers}) directly as `control`, plus `flagMaxWorkers` for --max-workers; resolveMaxWorkers is exported for the CLI's status output.
